newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: IMF mission expected in Pakistan next week.
newsitem.headline: IMF mission expected in Pakistan next week.

text.p: An International Monetary Fund mission is due to arrive in Pakistan next week to review the country's economic performance and discuss Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif's structural reform plans, an IMF source said on Friday.
The source said the mission was likely to arrive on Wednesday for talks that could last about two weeks.
The government expects the IMF, which scrapped a standby loan to Pakistan in March, to discuss a new medium-term lending programme under its Enhanced Structural Adjustment Facility.
